codes.ADVISORY_COMMIT_PARENT_NOT_SINGLE: An explicit commit repair has zero or multiple parents, so the pre-repair snapshot is not defined by v0.2.
codes.ADVISORY_CVE_ALIAS_MISSING: No alias matches the exact frozen CVE identifier grammar.
codes.ADVISORY_GITHUB_REFERENCE_MALFORMED: A GitHub reference in an advisory is not an accepted exact URL form.
codes.ADVISORY_MALFORMED: The advisory does not satisfy the frozen structural grammar.
codes.ADVISORY_MALWARE: The exact malware predicate is true.
codes.ADVISORY_NO_ACCEPTED_REPAIR_REFERENCE: No explicit accepted GitHub commit or merged-PR repair anchor exists.
codes.ADVISORY_NO_PYPI_PACKAGE: No affected package has ecosystem exactly PyPI.
codes.ADVISORY_PR_DETAIL_INCOMPLETE: Required immutable PR detail is absent.
codes.ADVISORY_REPAIR_EPISODE_CONFLICT: Equal immutable repair identity resolves to conflicting pre-repair snapshots.
codes.ADVISORY_REPAIR_REFERENCE_MISMATCH: Captured repair metadata does not equal the explicit advisory reference.
codes.ADVISORY_REPAIR_REFERENCE_UNRESOLVED: An explicit accepted repair reference was not exactly resolved.
codes.ADVISORY_SOURCE_PATH_INVALID: The raw advisory is outside the frozen github-reviewed tree.
codes.ADVISORY_WITHDRAWN: The exact withdrawn predicate is true.
codes.BUGSINPY_DUPLICATE_FIELD: A metadata assignment repeats a field.
codes.BUGSINPY_INVALID_COMMIT: A buggy or fixed commit is not lowercase 40-hex.
codes.BUGSINPY_MALFORMED_LINE: A metadata line does not match the frozen non-executable grammar.
codes.BUGSINPY_PROJECT_MAPPING_MISSING: The project definition lacks an accepted canonical GitHub repository mapping.
codes.BUGSINPY_REQUIRED_FIELD_MISSING: A required whitelisted metadata field is absent.
codes.BUGSINPY_UNKNOWN_FIELD: A metadata assignment uses a non-whitelisted field.
codes.BUGSINPY_UNSAFE_VALUE: A metadata value is empty or contains shell-expansion syntax.
codes.GITHUB_ISSUE_LEAD_NO_MERGED_PR: An issue lead resolves to no merged pull request.
codes.GITHUB_PR_DETAIL_INCOMPLETE: number, base.sha, head.sha, or merge_commit_sha is missing or malformed.
codes.GITHUB_PR_NOT_MERGED: The candidate pull request is not merged.
codes.GITHUB_QUERY_AUTHENTICATION_UNAVAILABLE: Required read-only authentication was unavailable before source execution.
codes.GITHUB_REFERENCE_MALFORMED: A URL is not credential-free canonical HTTPS github.com form.
codes.GITHUB_REFERENCE_UNSUPPORTED: A GitHub URL is not an accepted repository, commit, or pull-request form.
codes.GITHUB_REPOSITORY_ID_MISSING: The positive GitHub repository numeric ID is absent.
codes.GITHUB_REPOSITORY_METADATA_MISSING: Required capture-time repository metadata is absent.
codes.GITHUB_REPOSITORY_METADATA_MISMATCH: Captured owner, name, and URL do not resolve to one repository identity.
codes.GITHUB_REPOSITORY_NOT_PUBLIC: Repository visibility is not exactly public.
codes.GITHUB_SEARCH_COUNT_DRIFT: total_count changed during one capture transaction.
codes.GITHUB_SEARCH_RESPONSE_MALFORMED: A required search response field is missing or malformed.
codes.GITHUB_SEARCH_RESULT_CAP_EXCEEDED: A query reports more than 1,000 results and is rejected without import.
codes.IDENTITY_CONFLICT: Positive immutable identity tokens conflict and automatic collapse is prohibited.
codes.REPAIR_ANCHOR_MISSING: An exact lowercase 40-hex repair commit SHA is absent.
codes.SOURCE_IDENTITY_FIELD_MISSING: A source ID, immutable source revision, or native source key is absent.
codes.SOURCE_OBJECT_MALFORMED: A raw source object cannot be structurally parsed.
codes.SOURCE_SNAPSHOT_MISSING: An immutable pre-repair snapshot is absent.
